summary: Navitas Semiconductor filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026 announcing the closing, effective that date, of its previously announced acquisition of Claros, Inc. under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated August 24, 2026, executed through wholly owned subsidiaries Compass Merger Sub 1 Inc. and Compass Merger Sub 2 LLC, with Shareholder Representative Services LLC acting for Claros securityholders. No purchase price, consideration mix, premium, financing, advisor or break fee is disclosed in the excerpt. A related press release and CEO letter frame the deal within the company's 'Navitas 2.0' transformation. Watch integration execution, disclosed deal economics in the press release, and any earnout or holdback terms governing the securityholder representative arrangements.
